name: single-leg-extension.html
instructions:
1. Select the desired resistance on the weight stack and insert the pin.
2. Adjust the seat so that the knees are directly in line with the axis of the machine.
3. Sit down and position one shin behind the pad at the base of the machine.
4. Take a deep breath and extend your leg as you flex your quadricep.
5. As you lock out the knee, exhale to complete the repetition.
6. Slowly lower your foot back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions on both sides.
